findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe use of eval/exec in Pillow
 * @description Detect any use of eval or exec which could lead to code injection if used with untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pillow-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of eval/exec may lead to code injection if used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Pillow may use eval/exec in plugins or tooling, which could be dangerous if fed untrusted data.

message.text: Use of eval/exec may lead to code injection if used with untrusted input.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Pillow command execution usage (library code only)
 * @description Detect uses of os.system and subprocess in Pillow library code, excluding tests and tooling
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pillow-command-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from API::CallNode apiCall
where
  apiCall =
    API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
    or apiCall = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall()
  and apiCall.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/PIL/%")
select apiCall, "Use of system/subprocess may lead to command injection if used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Pillow library code may invoke os.system or subprocess.* in ways that could be influenced by untrusted input, leading to command injection.

/**
 * @name Pillow unsafe deserialization
 * @description Detect uses of pickle, marshal, yaml.load, or shelve that may deserialize untrusted data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pillow-unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Pillow may use unsafe deserialization libraries on attacker-controlled data
